description: Erection of single storey side and front extension to garage
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (120k19/P00, 120k19/P01 and 120k19/P501; Received: 5 December 2019; 120k19/P502; Received: 13 February 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing garage.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear and side walls of the garage hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The garage hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those specified on the plans or such uses which are incidental to the house at 28 Park Drive, Acton, W3 8NA. For the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation, nor for business purposes.
